title: PEOPLE BADGES
author: Jup1t3r
solderingInstructions:
LEDs: Two LEDs (D1, D2) near center. Orient with the GREEN DOT toward the TOP of the board.
Resistor: Single resistor; no polarity.

title: PRIVATE LTE
author: Jup1t3r
specialInstructions: It is CRITICAL that you do not reverse this LED; it will blow it up.
solderingInstructions:
LED: Single through-hole LED pressed through the large hole. Bend and trim leads to make contact with the D1 pads; match the upside-down layout shown. Ensure correct orientation (flat side as indicated).
Resistor: Single resistor; no polarity.

title: RFID/NFC BADGE
author: Jup1t3r
specialInstructions: If using the provided NFC sticker, trim headers flush so they don’t interfere.
solderingInstructions:
LEDs: Two LEDs (D1, D2). Orient with the GREEN DOT toward the TOP of the board.
Resistor: Single resistor; no polarity.
Headers: Recommended to TRIM headers FLUSH with the top of the board; solder so only a small rounded solder blob remains on top.
Sticker: Center the NFC tag sticker on the top of the minibadge (may not be included in every one).

title: HACK IN THE BOX
author: Jup1t3r
solderingInstructions:
Inverter: Best soldered with hot air + solder paste. Dab a very small amount of paste on the 5 pads, place inverter in correct orientation, heat with hot air; add flux once paste starts to melt. Recommended hot air temp: 190°C.
LEDs: Mount with the BUBBLE part in the drilled hole; when badge is facing up, the back of the LED should match the guide image. LEDs come in BLUE/GREEN pairs.
Resistors: Two resistors (GREEN and BLUE); place on the proper side. No polarity.

title: RED TEAM
author: Jup1t3r
specialInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT bridge all 3 jumper pads; it can short and cause issues with the entire badge.
solderingInstructions:
LEDs: Three LEDs (D1, D2, D3). Orient GREEN DOT toward the BOTTOM and LEFT as shown.
Resistor: Single resistor; no polarity.
Jumper: Required. For BLINKING, solder middle+bottom pads. For SOLID ON, solder middle+top pads.

title: HACKER CHALLENGE
author: Jup1t3r
specialInstructions: EPROM programming can be done at the Hackers Challenge booth after soldering.
solderingInstructions:
LEDs: Two LEDs on the front (marked D3 and D3 in the guide) oriented with GREEN mark to the LEFT. Recommended: BLUE LED on top and ORANGE LED on bottom on the front. One LED on the back (D1) oriented with GREEN near the top; if green on both sides, the side with TWO legs goes toward the top.
Resistors: Three resistors; place as shown and do not mix up values (680, 100, 100).
EPROM: Very small; fits one way. Recommended solder paste + rework, but can be hand soldered. Inspect for bridges under magnification.

title: RADIATION BADGE
author: Jup1t3r
specialInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT bridge all 3 jumper pads; it can short and cause issues with the entire badge.
solderingInstructions:
LEDs: Three LEDs mount with the light-emitting side toward the board. Align the TRIANGLE cutout on the LED to the matching shape on the board.
Resistors: Three identical resistors; any order and orientation.
Jumper: Required. For BLINKING, solder middle+top pads. For SOLID ON, solder middle+bottom pads.

title: MATRIX BADGE
author: Jup1t3r
specialInstructions: CLOCK REQUIRED: must be connected to a badge with the Clock Pin enabled.
solderingInstructions:
LEDs: Four LEDs (2 RED, 2 BLUE). Place in the right order and orientation. Orientation: RED LEDs have Green Indicator facing DOWN; BLUE LEDs have Green Indicator facing UP.
Resistors: Two resistors—one for RED LEDs and one for BLUE LEDs—match placement as indicated in the guide.
